choose.when: WITH RECURSIVE visibility_chain AS ( SELECT visibility.visibility_key AS origin_key, visibility.object_type AS origin_object_type, visibility.object_id AS origin_object_id, visibility.visibility_key AS current_key, visibility.parent_visibility_key, visibility.object_type AS current_object_type, visibility.object_id AS current_object_id, visibility.mode, visibility.revision, 0 AS depth FROM wms_object_visibility visibility UNION ALL SELECT chain.origin_key, chain.origin_object_type, chain.origin_object_id, parent.visibility_key, parent.parent_visibility_key, parent.object_type, parent.object_id, parent.mode, parent.revision, chain.depth + 1 FROM visibility_chain chain JOIN wms_object_visibility parent ON parent.visibility_key = chain.parent_visibility_key WHERE chain.mode = 'INHERIT' AND chain.depth < 64 ), effective_visibility AS ( SELECT origin_key, origin_object_type, origin_object_id, current_key, current_object_type, current_object_id, mode, revision FROM visibility_chain WHERE mode IN ('VALUE', 'CLEAR') ), visible_storage AS ( SELECT storage.storage_id FROM wms_storage storage JOIN wms_warehouse warehouse ON warehouse.warehouse_id = storage.warehouse_id JOIN wms_object_visibility company_visibility ON company_visibility.object_type = 'COMPANY' AND company_visibility.object_id = warehouse.company_id AND company_visibility.mode = 'VALUE' JOIN effective_visibility storage_visibility ON storage_visibility.origin_object_type = 'STORAGE' AND storage_visibility.origin_object_id = storage.storage_id AND storage_visibility.mode = 'VALUE' WHERE storage.del_flag = '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_object_visibility_department company_department WHERE company_department.visibility_key = company_visibility.visibility_key AND company_department.dept_id = #{scope.deptId} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_object_visibility_department storage_department WHERE storage_department.visibility_key = storage_visibility.current_key AND storage_department.dept_id = #{scope.deptId} ) )
choose.otherwise: WITH visible_storage AS ( SELECT storage_id FROM wms_storage WHERE del_flag = '0' )

mapper.sql: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM visible_storage inventory_visibility WHERE inventory_visibility.storage_id = i.storage_id )

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT inventory_id, SUM(reserved_qty) AS active_reserved_qty FROM wms_inventory_reservation WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY inventory_id ) active_reservation ON active_reservation.inventory_id = i.inventory_id LEFT JOIN wms_material_logical_assignment assignment ON assignment.inventory_id = i.inventory_id LEFT JOIN wms_logical_scope_version scope_version ON scope_version.scope_version_id = assignment.scope_version_id LEFT JOIN wms_logical_scope logical_scope ON logical_scope.logical_scope_id = scope_version.logical_scope_id
mapper.select:
SELECT i.material_code AS material_code, MAX(i.material_name) AS material_name, COALESCE(i.warehouse_code, '') AS warehouse_code, COALESCE(i.storage_code, '') AS storage_code, COALESCE(i.unit, '') AS unit, COUNT(*) AS inventory_count, SUM(i.inventory_qty) AS inventory_qty, SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(i.reserved_qty, 0), COALESCE(active_reservation.active_reserved_qty, 0))) AS reserved_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN i.frozen_status = 1 THEN i.inventory_qty ELSE 0 END) AS frozen_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN i.frozen_status = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(i.inventory_qty - GREATEST(COALESCE(i.reserved_qty, 0), COALESCE(active_reservation.active_reserved_qty, 0)), 0) END) AS available_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN i.frozen_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS frozen_count, assignment.scope_version_id AS logical_scope_version_id, logical_scope.scope_code AS logical_scope_code, logical_scope.scope_name AS logical_scope_name, scope_version.rule_package_version_id AS rule_package_version_id, MAX(i.update_time) AS last_updated_at FROM wms_inventory i
WHERE GROUP BY i.material_code, COALESCE(i.warehouse_code, ''), COALESCE(i.storage_code, ''), COALESCE(i.unit, ''), assignment.scope_version_id, logical_scope.scope_code, logical_scope.scope_name, scope_version.rule_package_version_id ORDER BY i.material_code, COALESCE(i.warehouse_code, ''), COALESCE(i.storage_code, ''), COALESCE(i.unit, ''), assignment.scope_version_id

SELECT i.inventory_id, i.stock_unit_code, i.material_code, i.material_name, i.material_batch, i.date_code, i.supplier_code, i.supplier_name, i.plant_code, i.warehouse_code, i.zone_id, i.zone_code, i.storage_id, i.storage_code, i.container_id, i.container_code, i.compartment_code, i.inventory_qty, GREATEST(COALESCE(i.reserved_qty, 0), COALESCE(active_reservation.active_reserved_qty, 0)) AS reserved_qty, CASE WHEN i.frozen_status = 1 THEN i.inventory_qty ELSE 0 END AS frozen_qty, CASE WHEN i.frozen_status = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(i.inventory_qty - GREATEST(COALESCE(i.reserved_qty, 0), COALESCE(active_reservation.active_reserved_qty, 0)), 0) END AS available_qty, i.unit, i.status, i.frozen_status, i.inbound_status, i.quality_status, i.production_date, i.receiving_time, i.inbound_time, i.reserved_order_no, i.source_order_no, i.target_place, i.version, assignment.scope_version_id AS logical_scope_version_id, logical_scope.scope_code AS logical_scope_code, logical_scope.scope_name AS logical_scope_name, scope_version.rule_package_version_id AS rule_package_version_id, i.create_time, i.update_time FROM wms_inventory i
WHERE ORDER BY i.material_code, i.stock_unit_code, i.inventory_id

SELECT i.inventory_id, i.stock_unit_code, i.material_code, i.material_name, i.material_batch, i.date_code, i.supplier_code, i.supplier_name, i.plant_code, i.warehouse_code, i.zone_id, i.zone_code, i.storage_id, i.storage_code, i.container_id, i.container_code, i.compartment_code, i.inventory_qty, GREATEST(COALESCE(i.reserved_qty, 0), COALESCE(active_reservation.active_reserved_qty, 0)) AS reserved_qty, CASE WHEN i.frozen_status = 1 THEN i.inventory_qty ELSE 0 END AS frozen_qty, CASE WHEN i.frozen_status = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(i.inventory_qty - GREATEST(COALESCE(i.reserved_qty, 0), COALESCE(active_reservation.active_reserved_qty, 0)), 0) END AS available_qty, i.unit, i.status, i.frozen_status, i.inbound_status, i.quality_status, i.production_date, i.receiving_time, i.inbound_time, i.reserved_order_no, i.source_order_no, i.target_place, i.version, assignment.scope_version_id AS logical_scope_version_id, logical_scope.scope_code AS logical_scope_code, logical_scope.scope_name AS logical_scope_name, scope_version.rule_package_version_id AS rule_package_version_id, i.create_time, i.update_time FROM wms_inventory i
WHERE i.inventory_id = #{inventoryId} AND i.del_flag = '0'

SELECT production_info_id, material_code, material_type, production_date, material_batch, supplier_code, supplier_name, customer_code, customer_name, length_value, width_value, height_value, dimension_unit, bom_level, bom_qty, bom_version, finished_material_code, finished_material_type, parse_version, revision FROM wms_production_info WHERE inventory_id = #{inventoryId}

SELECT attribute_key, seq_no, value_text, value_number, value_date, value_datetime, unit, source_ref FROM wms_material_attribute_value WHERE production_info_id = #{productionInfoId} ORDER BY attribute_key, seq_no

WITH RECURSIVE load_ancestry AS ( SELECT n.load_node_id AS current_node_id, n.node_type, n.inventory_id, i.stock_unit_code, i.material_code, n.container_id, c.container_code, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS parent_node_id, n.status, n.revision, 0 AS depth FROM wms_load_node n LEFT JOIN wms_inventory i ON i.inventory_id = n.inventory_id LEFT JOIN wms_container c ON c.container_id = n.container_id WHERE n.inventory_id = #{inventoryId} UNION ALL SELECT p.load_node_id, p.node_type, p.inventory_id, pi.stock_unit_code, pi.material_code, p.container_id, pc.container_code, a.current_node_id, p.status, p.revision, a.depth + 1 FROM load_ancestry a JOIN wms_load_relation r ON r.child_node_id = a.current_node_id JOIN wms_load_node p ON p.load_node_id = r.parent_node_id LEFT JOIN wms_inventory pi ON pi.inventory_id = p.inventory_id LEFT JOIN wms_container pc ON pc.container_id = p.container_id WHERE a.depth < 64 ) SELECT current_node_id AS load_node_id, node_type, inventory_id, stock_unit_code, material_code, container_id, container_code, parent_node_id, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS root_node_id, depth, status, revision, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(16)) AS location_kind, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS storage_id, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(64)) AS storage_code FROM load_ancestry ORDER BY depth DESC

WITH RECURSIVE load_tree AS ( SELECT n.load_node_id, n.node_type, n.inventory_id, i.stock_unit_code, i.material_code, n.container_id, c.container_code, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS parent_node_id, n.load_node_id AS root_node_id, n.status, n.revision, 0 AS depth FROM wms_load_node n LEFT JOIN wms_inventory i ON i.inventory_id = n.inventory_id LEFT JOIN wms_container c ON c.container_id = n.container_id WHERE n.load_node_id = #{rootNodeId} UNION ALL SELECT child.load_node_id, child.node_type, child.inventory_id, child_inventory.stock_unit_code, child_inventory.material_code, child.container_id, child_container.container_code, rel.parent_node_id, tree.root_node_id, child.status, child.revision, tree.depth + 1 FROM load_tree tree JOIN wms_load_relation rel ON rel.parent_node_id = tree.load_node_id JOIN wms_load_node child ON child.load_node_id = rel.child_node_id LEFT JOIN wms_inventory child_inventory ON child_inventory.inventory_id = child.inventory_id LEFT JOIN wms_container child_container ON child_container.container_id = child.container_id WHERE tree.depth < 64 ) SELECT tree.load_node_id, tree.node_type, tree.inventory_id, tree.stock_unit_code, tree.material_code, tree.container_id, tree.container_code, tree.parent_node_id, tree.root_node_id, tree.depth, tree.status, tree.revision, info.location_kind, info.storage_id, st.storage_code FROM load_tree tree LEFT JOIN wms_storage_info info ON info.root_node_id = tree.root_node_id LEFT JOIN wms_storage st ON st.storage_id = info.storage_id ORDER BY tree.depth, tree.load_node_id

SELECT i.inventory_id FROM wms_inventory i WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.inventory_id IN
#{inventoryId}

SELECT info.root_node_id, info.location_kind, info.storage_id, st.storage_code, wh.warehouse_code, zone.zone_code, info.revision FROM wms_storage_info info LEFT JOIN wms_storage st ON st.storage_id = info.storage_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse_zone zone ON zone.zone_id = st.zone_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse wh ON wh.warehouse_id = st.warehouse_id WHERE info.root_node_id = #{rootNodeId}
mapper.sql: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_material_trace_item visible_item WHERE visible_item.trace_id = history.trace_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_material_trace_item hidden_item WHERE hidden_item.trace_id = history.trace_id AND ( ( hidden_item.physical_from_storage_id IS NULL AND hidden_item.physical_to_storage_id IS NULL ) OR ( hidden_item.physical_from_storage_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM visible_storage from_visibility WHERE from_visibility.storage_id = hidden_item.physical_from_storage_id ) ) OR ( hidden_item.physical_to_storage_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM visible_storage to_visibility WHERE to_visibility.storage_id = hidden_item.physical_to_storage_id ) ) ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM wms_material_trace_history history WHERE
ORDER BY history.occurred_at DESC, history.trace_id DESC

SELECT task.task_id, task.business_type, task.business_id, task.line_id, task.allocation_unit_id, task.round_no, task.phase, task.task_key, task.plan_type, task.plan_instance_id, task.input_hash, task.status, task.revision, COALESCE(instance.plan_status, 'ABSENT') AS instance_status, instance.instance_version, event.event_code AS latest_event_code, event.event_status AS latest_event_status, event.effect_result AS latest_effect_result, instance.started_at, instance.ended_at, task.update_time AS updated_at FROM wms_business_task task LEFT JOIN iws_process_instance instance ON instance.id = task.plan_instance_id LEFT JOIN iws_process_event event ON event.id = ( SELECT candidate.id FROM iws_process_event candidate WHERE candidate.instance_id = task.plan_instance_id ORDER BY candidate.update_time DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE ORDER BY task.update_time DESC, task.task_id DESC

SELECT definition.rule_definition_id, definition.rule_key, definition.purpose, definition.rule_name, definition.scope_type, definition.status, definition.current_version_id, definition.revision, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_rule_version version WHERE version.rule_definition_id = definition.rule_definition_id) AS version_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_rule_version version WHERE version.rule_definition_id = definition.rule_definition_id AND version.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_version_count, definition.update_time AS updated_at FROM wms_rule_definition definition WHERE ORDER BY definition.update_time DESC, definition.rule_definition_id DESC

SELECT definition.rule_definition_id, definition.rule_key, definition.purpose, definition.rule_name, definition.scope_type, definition.status, definition.current_version_id, definition.revision, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_rule_version version WHERE version.rule_definition_id = definition.rule_definition_id) AS version_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_rule_version version WHERE version.rule_definition_id = definition.rule_definition_id AND version.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_version_count, definition.update_time AS updated_at FROM wms_rule_definition definition WHERE definition.rule_definition_id = #{definitionId}

SELECT rule_version_id, rule_definition_id, version_no, condition_json, result_json, attribute_bindings_json, canonical_digest, status, published_at, published_by FROM wms_rule_version version WHERE version.rule_definition_id = #{definitionId} ORDER BY version.version_no DESC, version.rule_version_id DESC

SELECT package_version.package_version_id, package_version.package_code, package_version.version_no, package_version.canonical_digest, package_version.status, package_version.published_at, package_version.published_by, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_rule_package_member member WHERE member.package_version_id = package_version.package_version_id) AS member_count FROM wms_rule_package_version package_version WHERE ORDER BY package_version.update_time DESC, package_version.package_version_id DESC

SELECT package_version.package_version_id, package_version.package_code, package_version.version_no, package_version.canonical_digest, package_version.status, package_version.published_at, package_version.published_by, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_rule_package_member member WHERE member.package_version_id = package_version.package_version_id) AS member_count FROM wms_rule_package_version package_version WHERE package_version.package_version_id = #{packageVersionId}

SELECT member.purpose, member.rule_version_id, member.revision, definition.rule_key, definition.rule_name, definition.scope_type, version.version_no, version.status FROM wms_rule_package_member member LEFT JOIN wms_rule_version version ON version.rule_version_id = member.rule_version_id LEFT JOIN wms_rule_definition definition ON definition.rule_definition_id = version.rule_definition_id WHERE member.package_version_id = #{packageVersionId} ORDER BY member.purpose, member.rule_version_id

SELECT i.inventory_id, i.stock_unit_code, i.material_code, i.material_name, i.storage_code, i.container_code, i.inventory_qty, i.unit, i.status, i.frozen_status, i.inbound_status, CASE WHEN i.stock_unit_code = #{code} THEN 'STOCK_UNIT' WHEN i.container_code = #{code} THEN 'CONTAINER' WHEN i.storage_code = #{code} THEN 'STORAGE' WHEN i.material_code = #{code} THEN 'MATERIAL' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS match_type FROM wms_inventory i WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM visible_storage inventory_visibility WHERE inventory_visibility.storage_id = i.storage_id ) AND (i.stock_unit_code = #{code} OR i.container_code = #{code} OR i.storage_code = #{code} OR i.material_code = #{code}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.stock_unit_code = #{code} THEN 1 WHEN i.container_code = #{code} THEN 2 WHEN i.storage_code = #{code} THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, i.material_code, i.stock_unit_code, i.inventory_id LIMIT #{limit}
